case_summary: Adult dairy cow down 24h post-calving with cold extremities and weak pulse — consistent with periparturient hypocalcemia (milk fever).

recommended_actions.action: Administer 500 mL 23% calcium borogluconate IV slowly with cardiac monitoring
Follow with 500 mL SQ split at two sites
Provide oral calcium gel/bolus after standing
Soft bedding; assist to sternal; prevent bloat

products.name: Calcium Borogluconate 23%
products.dose: 500 mL IV slow; then 500 mL SQ (split)
cautions: Cardiac arrhythmia risk if IV too rapid

follow_up: Monitor appetite, rumen motility, and stance

job_sheet.title: Milk Fever – Immediate Treatment
instructions: IV 23% Ca borogluconate over 10–15 min with auscultation
Provide oral Ca bolus when safe
Assist rising with hip lifter/float if needed
